Fact.Name: ctc8862Required
Fact.Description: Used to indicate whether Part III of Schedule 8862 is applicable

Fact.Name: Received CTC improper claims
Fact.Description: Since 2015 (TY -8?) the IRS has reduced or disallowed the TP or MFJ spouse's CTC, ACTC, or ODC for reasons other than a math error.

Fact.Name: Received CTC improper Claims notice
Fact.Description: Whether the TP received a letter from the IRS telling them they're not allowed to take CTC, ACTC, or ODC for a number of years

Fact.Name: CTC improper claims notice expired
Fact.Description: Whether the improper claims notice that the TP previously received is far enough in the past to be expired. E.g. They could not file for 2 years, and it has been at least 2 years

Fact.Name: CTC Has Filed CTC or ODC since notice expired
Fact.Description: Whether the TP has filed for CTC or ODC again since the notice has expired. The first time a taxpayer files after their notice has expired, they need to fill out form 8862.

Fact.Name: Flow CTC Ask Improper Claims Expiration
Fact.Description: Whether the flow should ask a person if their CTC improper claims notice has expired

Fact.Name: Modified AGI for purposes of dependent credits
Include Schedule 8812 in tax return PDF
Fact.Description: Whether the tax return PDF should include Schedule 8812.

Fact.Name: Display value for PDF Schedule 8812, Line 18a
Fact.Description: Earned income with all combat pay if completing Part II-A; undefined otherwise.

Fact.Name: Display value for PDF Schedule 8812, Line 18b
Fact.Description: Nontaxable combat pay if completing Part II-A; undefined otherwise.

Fact.Name: Display value for PDF Schedule 8812, Line 21
Fact.Description: Social Security taxes withheld if completing Part II-B; undefined otherwise.

Fact.Name: Display value for PDF Schedule 8812, Line 24
Fact.Description: Earned income credit if completing Part II-B; undefined otherwise.
